name: Westwood Village
summary: Westwood Village is a community shopping center located at the heart of Magnolia, Texas, serving the growing northwest Houston suburbs with convenient access to neighboring master-planned communities. Managed by Regency Centers, this open-air retail destination offers a mix of restaurants, salons, medical offices, and fitness facilities tailored to meet the daily needs of local families.
demographics: Westwood Village serves the rapidly growing Magnolia area and neighboring master-planned communities in northwest Houston, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The trade area consists largely of young families with children, homeowners aged 30-55, who have relocated to this suburban area for quality schools and newer housing developments. Shopping patterns reflect convenience-oriented visits for grocery, dining, personal services, and medical needs, with customers typically visiting 2-3 times per week for everyday necessities rather than destination shopping trips.
description: Westwood Village is a thriving community shopping center strategically positioned at the epicenter of Magnolia, Texas, along Farm to Market Road 2978. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, this open-air retail destination serves as the primary commercial hub for the rapidly expanding northwest Houston suburbs and provides direct access to neighboring master-planned communities. The center caters to the daily needs of local residents with a carefully curated mix of essential services including restaurants, salons, medical spaces, and fitness facilities. With a strong 4.4-star rating from nearly 2,400 Google reviews, Westwood Village has established itself as a trusted gathering place for the Magnolia community. The property benefits from Regency Centers' Fresh Look® philosophy and commitment to creating best-in-class retail environments that connect quality retailers with thriving neighborhoods throughout the Houston-Baytown-Sugar Land metropolitan market.
